drills.label: Cold open
drills.question_line: SAM: Here is your opening scenario. A utility runs Claude for its back office
drills.answer_line: SAM: So the answer is A: OpenAI for the phone channel
drills.stem: A utility runs Claude for its back office. It wants an assistant that answers customer phone calls, talks naturally and copes when callers interrupt mid-sentence. What should it use for the voice layer?

options.A: OpenAI's full-duplex voice model for the phone channel, with Claude kept on the back-office work
options.B: Wrap separate speech-to-text and text-to-speech services around the Claude Messages API, to stay with one model vendor
options.C: Move the whole estate to OpenAI so one vendor covers voice and back office
options.D: Run the phone line on Claude Managed Agents, because it handles long sessions

drills.why: The constraint is a modality: natural, interruptible conversation. OpenAI ships full-duplex voice first-party; the research found no Anthropic equivalent. B is a voice pipeline the customer must build and own, C discards a working back office, D answers a different question.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. A European insurer has OpenAI's approval
drills.answer_line: SAM: That is the trap. A self-hosted sandbox moves tool execution
drills.stem: An insurer has OpenAI's approval for zero data retention and must keep it on everything its claims agent touches. Processing must be in the EU, and the team wants to save engineering time. What fits?

options.A: The Agents API with OpenAI-hosted sandboxes
options.B: The Agents API with a self-hosted sandbox in the insurer's own EU cloud
options.C: Run the loop with the Agents SDK on its own infrastructure, call an EU data residency project, keep state in its own store, and check zero data retention eligibility per endpoint
options.D: Keep the loop simple and store state in OpenAI's Conversations API

drills.why: The Agents API beta is US-only and not eligible for zero data retention, with any sandbox. Conversations is on the not-eligible list. Running the loop yourself costs engineering, which is the price of the constraint.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. For each statement, say true or false.
drills.answer_line: SAM: All four. Subagents inherit the parent's sandbox
drills.prompt: True or false? 1) The Codex CLI is open source under Apache 2.0. 2) A Codex subagent can be given a looser sandbox than its parent. 3) Claude Code reads AGENTS.md when a repository has no CLAUDE.md. 4) Codex hooks run prompt-based handlers as well as command handlers.
drills.answer: 1) True. 2) False: subagents inherit the parent sandbox and cannot override it. 3) True. 4) False: prompt handlers are parsed but skipped; only command and MCP tool handlers run.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. A retailer has a large A W S spending commitment.
drills.answer_line: SAM: B. It meets both constraints
drills.stem: A retailer's developers want Codex and GPT models. Spend must draw down its AWS commitment, and no new vendor contract is allowed this year. What do you recommend?

options.A: ChatGPT Enterprise bought direct from OpenAI
options.B: OpenAI's models on Amazon Bedrock, with Codex pointed at Bedrock
options.C: Claude on Bedrock instead, because Claude is the only leading lab's model there

drills.why: B meets both constraints with the product asked for. A is a new contract off the commitment, C has been false since June 2026, D draws down the wrong cloud's commitment.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. Choose two. A bank's C T O asks
drills.answer_line: SAM: A and B. C is Claude's
drills.stem: Choose two. A bank's CTO asks where OpenAI is genuinely stronger than Claude today. Which two claims survive a customer who has used both?

options.B: Reach: Codex in the consumer app down to the free tier, and models sold direct, on Azure and on Bedrock
options.C: The top of the independent agentic leaderboards
options.E: A more stable platform with fewer retirements

drills.why: C is Claude's on Artificial Analysis and Arena's agent board. D is parity. E runs the other way: Assistants, Agent Builder and Evals retired within about fifteen months.

drills.question_line: SAM: Recall first. Pause and name the four segments
drills.answer_line: ALEX: The model; platform and agent stack
drills.prompt: Name the four segments, and the question to ask the customer in each.
drills.answer: The model; platform and agent stack; Codex and ChatGPT Work; enterprise and the clouds. Which tier are you comparing; which layer did you build on; who already uses Codex; whose commitment does the spend draw down.
